answer: Each identity must prove itself with one unique contribution before dawn of its first epoch: a merged code commit or published dataset accepted by a maintainer outside its sponsor graph, plus 1,000 POA locked 45 days. A farm of 200 fakes needs 200 original artifacts and 200 independent maintainers, about $35 and 4 hours each. If over 40% of a batch traces to one maintainer or shares one code haven, the cluster freezes and every bond slashes 100%. A 150-agent ring was caught when 132 commits drew nectar from four maintainers new to outside review.
